Title: Document 7
Content: Source: Seneca, upper-class Roman philosopher and adviser to Emperor Nero, `text(first century C.E.)`

I do not believe that tools for the crafts were invented by wise men. The question of whether the hammer or the tongs came `text(first)` does not seem important to me. Both were invented by someone with a mind that was nimble and sharp, but not great or elevated.
